$comment: Effect catalog (v6.3 D04, C8): which class an effect belongs to and how a parent factor is composed under stated conditions. Classification is not coverage: which members an operator handles is in the operator coverage contracts (contracts/semantics/coverage/). The legacy '<x>_efficiency' pattern and validate.IMPLIED_CORRECTIONS stay as legacy adapters; this catalog never replaces them for old entry points.

classes.definition: inefficiencies of the selection chain; a new member is added here explicitly and is never covered by an operator until its coverage contract lists it

effects.definition: the estimated background (possibly zero) subtracted from selected counts
Bin-to-bin migration between truth and reco (the matrix itself)
legacy bare term: the inefficiency of the whole selection; keeps its legacy meaning and is never split into members automatically
Out-of-fiducial truth events (truth outside the declared phase space)
Reco events with no matching truth event (background-like, applied in reco space)
Cutoff transmission: per bin of the variable, the fraction of the live time in which that bin lies above the declared geomagnetic (or other) cutoff threshold, with its safety factor
division by the bin width of the variable the result is differential in

conditions: acceptance is geometric (area times solid angle) and contains no efficiency
live time is the detector live time of the same data selection
any further factor (for example a geomagnetic cutoff fraction) is listed as its own child; without it this composition does not apply
compositions.convention: exposure = acceptance x live time under the conditions above; an effective exposure that contains efficiency is not this composition

conditions: acceptance is geometric (area times solid angle) and contains no efficiency
live time is the detector live time of the same data selection
cutoff transmission is evaluated per bin of the variable from the same periods as the live time (the product live time x transmission is the collection time per bin)
compositions.convention: exposure = acceptance x live time x cutoff transmission (collection time) under the conditions above; the two-child composition exposure_acceptance_livetime applies only where no cutoff factor is needed
